posts.text:
Sales: Our coffee bean sales rose by 25% in November.
Customers: The number of regular customers grew from 150 to 300 this year.
Prices: Our coffee bean prices climbed to 500 baht per kilogram.
Costs: Our roasting and material costs fell to 20,000 baht last month
Online: We experienced a sharp rise in online orders this quarter.
Branches & staff: Our roastery staff remained steady at 8 people.

Sales: The restaurant averages 1,500 bowls and 150,000 THB in monthly revenue, with steady growth targets
Customers: Targeting young locals and international tourists, monthly experience-seeking customers grew from 30 to 1,400.
Prices: Menu items are priced affordably between 55 and 150 THB.
Costs: Direct local sourcing keeps operational costs low to protect margins within the 55–150 THB price range
Online: Short-form videos on TikTok and Instagram, online bookings, and delivery apps drive brand awareness and younger traffic.
Branches & staff: A lean team of artisans and staff operates a single flagship branch, delivering live noodle-making and table-side gyoza experiences.

Sales: Monthly sales reached a peak during the summer sale, dropped significantly afterward, and then rose steadily with the new collection release.
Customers: New customers surged during the seasonal sale, whereas regular customers remained the majority during regular periods and new collection launches.
Prices: Our products range from affordable daily wear starting at 350 THB to premium items costing over 5,000 THB.
Costs: Our monthly costs total approximately 4.29 million THB, including 2.85 million THB for staff salaries, 240,000 THB for rent at our first branch, and 1.2 million THB for production costs.
Online: Online views, orders, and followers grew dramatically alongside the success of the new capsule collections.
Branches & staff: The number of physical shops and staff increased slightly as the company expanded to over 200 stores worldwide.

Sales: Sales increased steadily over the past four years, reaching 67 million baht in 2026.
Customers: The brand continues to attract young customers who prefer modern fashion and unique styles.
Prices: The brand continues to offer affordable prices while maintaining high-quality and comfortable clothing.
Costs: The company increasingly uses organic cotton and recycled materials to support environmental sustainability.
Online: The brand focuses on following the latest fashion trends and making stylish clothing accessible to more customers.
Branches & staff: The company has expanded its number of branches steadily since 2023.

Sales: Tea-O-Clock’s monthly sales grew steadily by 25% in 2024 after opening modern kiosks near university campuses.
Customers: New student customers increased dramatically from 500 to 1,200 people per shop last year after launching handmade boba milk tea.
Prices: Our average drink price remained steady at 45 baht per cup in 2025 to keep menu options affordable for students.
Costs: Imported tea leaf and dairy costs rose sharply by 15% over the past year.
Online: Online delivery app orders climbed significantly by 35% during the rainy season in 2025, keeping total revenue balanced.
Branches & staff: The number of Tea-O-Clock branches grew steadily from 10 to 25 shops between 2022 and 2025 across Thailand and Asia

Sales: Sales increased significantly by 7% in 2026.
Revenue steadily grew to 100 million baht despite the COVID-19 pandemic.
Customers: Customers grew from 2,500 to 5,000.
The number of customers doubled because of ChickChick's unique taste, signature aroma, and variety of sauces.
Prices: Product prices remained steady in 2026.
ChickChick maintained its product prices to attract customers and remain competitive in the market.
Costs: Ingredient costs increased gradually.
The costs of butter, herbs, spices, and other ingredients increased as the company expanded its menu.
Online: Online orders rose rapidly by 20% in 2026.
More customers ordered ChickChick through LINE MAN and Grab because of their convenience and fast delivery services.
Branches & staff: Branches gradually increased from 10 to 15 over the past three years.
ChickChick expanded its branches in city centers and residential areas to serve more customers
